description:
The twenty-one hero cards -- one per class. A hero is the card an opponent damages to win; it is what Star Wars: Unlimited calls a base, renamed when this project renamed bases to heroes. Each carries a starting HP and a single ability.

HP economy: 20 is the notional blank baseline. Below 20 means the ability was bought with health; above means health was paid to accept a drawback, which is why the Lich sits at 25 for starting a card down.

'Your leader' means the class's Leader card, a separate card from this one. The two are both called heroes in conversation and that collision is not yet resolved in the data.

data.ability: Epic Action [discard your hand]: Deal 3 damage to each unit.

Epic Action: Defeat a non-leader unit that has 3 or less remaining HP.
